avis.titre: Smells like a gas station bathroom…
avis.texte: I LOVE Kate Somerville's moisturizer, and was looking forward to this foaming cleanser. But this is 100% my most regrettable skincare experience in a decade, and I have tried a LOT of products. If you read through the reviews, there are many people with experiences like mine, enough that I think most people would be better off finding another cleanser than gambling with this poorly formulated product. I do lean towards natural brands, but my bad review isn't just about the -disgusting- port-a-Pottie air-freshener smell. I am 37 and, thanks to this garbage, dealing with the worst breakouts of my adult life. This is not purging, I use AHA/BHA products, and retinol, and have managed that when switching products before. This is some chemical ingredient, that this brand chose, that is causing cystic, painful, slow healing pustules resulting in discoloration for months (2 right now) after ditching the product. Pro: Big bottle … that's all I've got. Con: Heavily (badly) scented Strips moisture and leaves a filmy feeling Caused a reaction resulting in cystic acne Does not compliment the weight of KS moisturizers Did I mention the smell… I do have sensitive skin, but I've used products from many other brands recently with no reaction, including: Perricone MD (also a lot of fragrance), kinship, murad, acure, strivectin, SkinFx, bioassence, good molecules, and cocokind. Probably others.

avis.titre: Versatile cleanser for all skin types
avis.texte: I love the Kate Somerville Exfolikate cleanser and the moisturizer! It's perfect and gentle enough for daily use and doesn't make my skin feel tight or stripped after washing. A little goes a long way too, will be repurchasing for sure!

This face wash and skin care line has been a game changer for me! When I first started using this a few years back, I was really struggling with my moisture barrier and acne, and couldn't seem to find the right combo of products to get my skin under control. When I switched my routine and started using this face wash on my face, my skin really started to improve within a few weeks and breakouts had pretty much stopped. I hadn't realized I stripped my skin of its' natural moisture barrier because I was using too many products to treat my acne and this product broke the cycle I was stuck in by balancing getting the skin clean without stripping it. It feels great on the skin and leaves my face feeling fresh and clean. My skin texture has improved over time as well. While this skin care line is pricey, it has been worth every penny for me.

I absolutely loved this product after receiving a sample. After running out I bought the 4 oz cleanser. During the time I was using it, I developed rashes around my eyes, swollen eyes, itchy skin, allergic reaction. At first, I was sure this wasnt the cause and that something else was causing it. I was nearing my birthday and didn't want my eyes to ruin my birthday so I rushed to the dr got a steroid prescribed and my skin cleared up, at this point i didnt think it was the cleanser causing my reaction. After a month and a half and not being on steroids all my symptoms returned and I went to my dermatologist that told me i was having an allergic reaction to something i was using. He prescribed another cream but i still had no clue what was causing it. Ive had reactions to other face products and decided to read reviews to check if anyone else had had the same reaction. I finally decided to stop using the cleaser a week before a wedding and my skin started feeling better. Its been two weeks now since Ive used the cleanser and my skin is clear. I really love this product and loved hwo it left the rest of my skin feeling but I do not enjoy the reaction around my eyes.
